notablePrerequisites:
Born to Drive and Nurturing Presence attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Devoted Druid, giving Devoted Druid +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
